description: This Java class 'FileHelper' provides utility methods for file handling within the RomRaider project, including file chooser dialogs, file saving, and file path management.

classes.name: FileHelper
classes.description: A utility class for handling file operations such as creating file choosers, saving profiles, and managing file paths.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Returns a File object for the given path or the user's home directory if the path is null or empty.

methods.name: getProfileFileChooser
methods.description: Creates a JFileChooser configured for selecting ECU Logger User Profile XML files.

methods.name: getDefinitionFileChooser
methods.description: Creates a JFileChooser configured for selecting ECU Logger Definition XML files.

methods.name: saveProfileToFile
methods.description: Saves a UserProfile object to a specified file, appending '.xml' if necessary, and returns the file path.

methods.name: getLoggerOutputDirFileChooser
methods.description: Creates a JFileChooser for selecting a directory for logger output, defaulting to the last used directory if valid.

methods.name: getFileChooser
methods.description: Private helper that creates a JFileChooser with a specific file filter based on description and extensions.

methods.name: getFileChooser
methods.description: Private helper that creates a JFileChooser initialized to the directory of a given file.
